name: gizza-ai/parse-ethernet-frame
summary: Decode an Ethernet II / 802.3 frame from hex

tool.description: Decode an Ethernet II or IEEE 802.3 frame given as a hex string into structured fields: destination and source MAC addresses (with broadcast/multicast and locally-administered flags), any 802.1Q / 802.1ad VLAN tags (TPID, PCP, DEI, VID — including Q-in-Q), the EtherType (named when known, e.g. IPv4/ARP/IPv6/LLDP) or the 802.3 length, and the payload length plus payload hex. Input may contain spaces, colons, dashes, or a 0x prefix. Returns JSON. Runs locally.

frame.description: The Ethernet frame as a hex string (without preamble/SFD/FCS). Spaces, colons, dashes, and a 0x prefix are ignored, e.g. 'ffffffffffff 001122334455 0806 ...'.
